release.status: Pre-v1 development with beta releases and per-commit canary tags plus workflow artifacts; public stable installation is not yet claimed.

platforms.detail: portable compiler/encoder checks; native JIT ABI is not claimed

concurrency.runtime: concurrent compile/instantiate/execute on distinct objects is race-tested
concurrency.compiledModule: compile once and instantiate many; blanket method-level goroutine-safety is not yet documented
concurrency.instance: one active caller at a time; serialize calls
concurrency.separateInstances: concurrent callers are accepted, but native Wasm activations are serialized process-wide
concurrency.nativeExecutionParallelism: one process-wide native activation at a time
concurrency.resultLifetime: instance-owned result buffer remains valid only until the next call

limits.declaredTables: partial: initial/minimum size checked; growth maximum is not enforced by Policy.MaxTableEntries

wasi.delivery: outside core; external plugin integration exists but its function-level support was not audited here

verification.accountingNote: Normal, guard-page, WebAssembly 1.0, 2.0, SIMD, and pinned Core 3 assertion gates; the Core 3 total comes from the zero-gap checked-in baseline.

proposals.name: f32 / f64 ceil / floor / trunc / nearest / copysign
Control flow: block / loop / if / else / br / br_if / br_table / return

wazero.method: pinned upstream regression corpus integrated into the unified package-test surface

wasmtime.claim: No full Wasmtime suite claim is published.

security.recommendedAdditionalBoundary: process or container isolation for hostile multi-tenant guests

benchmarks.allocationMeaning: Go heap allocation traffic measured during the named operation

concurrency.label: race-tested concurrent compile, instantiate, and execute coverage

suiteAssertions.accountingNote: Legacy SPECTEST.md MVP passes plus SIMD passes; do not substitute this sum for the mixed-unit public verification total.

verification.accountingNote: Published MVP and SIMD assertion baselines.

facts.accountingNote: SPECTEST.md, SIMD, and Core 3 use different corpus and accounting boundaries; do not combine or substitute their counts.

benchmarks.caveat: Compare wago with other runtimes only within the same workload and architecture. Architectures are measured on different machines.
